run_jmeter_install: run the script to install Apache JMeter 5.3 and plugins to a given Windows path
run_shell_command: run a shell command and capture its return code, stdout, and stderr output
download_jmeter: download and unzip Apache JMeter 5.3 to a specified installation directory on Windows
install_jmeter_plugins: install JMeter plugins including synthesis, filterresults, mergeresults, cmd, and perfmon
setup_jmeter_plugin_manager: setup the JMeter plugin manager CMD installer by running the Java class via subprocess
